name: primitives-texts-morphing
title: Morphing Text
description: A big looping headline that periodically changes word, with each letter fading and sliding into its new position, and a smaller supporting line morphing underneath.
use: A short rotating headline should draw the eye while the rest of the page stays still.
avoid: Long sentences or copy that must stay readable: the blur and endless loop make it hard to follow.
a11y: Each phrase is exposed as one aria-label with the letters hidden, but motion ignores reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A huge bold white word and a smaller grey line, both centred on a near-black stage. Mid-change the letters stretch, soften out of focus and briefly overlap as old glyphs leave and new ones enter.
behaves: Every couple of seconds the pair of phrases advances: shared letters glide to their new spots while the rest blur out and back in. The cycle repeats without stopping and the small line is offset slightly in time.
customise: The text array, hold time, loop flag and per-letter enter and exit variants are props; the morph layout itself is fixed in the source.
weight: light: One animated span per letter, and only the swapping word is in motion at a time.
